# AZ-104 Practice Section 3

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-az-104-question-set-3)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_az104.svg)

Practice questions for the **Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)** certification exam. This third question set explores territory the earlier sets left untouched — hybrid identity with cloud sync, policy exemptions, NAT gateways and gateway transit, immutable storage, archive rehydration, customer-managed keys, Azure Compute Gallery images, and item-level backup recovery.

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** — 12 case study-linked (4 scenarios) + 24 standalone; single choice, multiple choice, ordering, and matching
- **Topics**:
  - Manage Azure Identities & Governance (8 questions)
  - Implement & Manage Storage (7 questions)
  - Deploy & Manage Azure Compute Resources (9 questions)
  - Implement & Manage Virtual Networking (7 questions)
  - Monitor & Maintain Azure Resources (5 questions)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **scenario-based conceptual understanding**. It does not cover hands-on lab exercises, CLI/PowerShell command syntax drills, or pricing calculator questions. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of Azure concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.

## Usage

This repository is designed to be used with the [Quiz Player](https://quizplay.io). Click the badge above to launch the quiz directly.
